import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='viridis', 
                             s=df['Physical Activity Level']/2, alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Stress Level\n(Size = Physical Activity)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=10)

# 2. Distribution of Sleep Duration by Gender and BMI Category
bmi_order = ['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    gender_data = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    for i, bmi in enumerate(bmi_order):
        bmi_data = gender_data[gender_data['BMI Category'] == bmi]
        if not bmi_data.empty:
            axes[0, 1].hist(bmi_data['Sleep Duration'], alpha=0.5, 
                           label=f'{gender} - {bmi}', bins=15)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Gender and BMI', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].legend(fontsize=9, ncol=2)

# 3. Average Metrics by Occupation (top 10)
occupation_stats = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean',
    'Stress Level': 'mean',
    'Daily Steps': 'mean'
}).sort_values('Sleep Duration', ascending=False).head(10)

x = np.arange(len(occupation_stats))
width = 0.2
axes[0, 2].bar(x - 1.5*width, occupation_stats['Sleep Duration'], width, label='Sleep Duration', color='skyblue')
axes[0, 2].bar(x - 0.5*width, occupation_stats['Quality of Sleep']/2, width, label='Quality/2', color='lightgreen')
axes[0, 2].bar(x + 0.5*width, occupation_stats['Stress Level'], width, label='Stress Level', color='salmon')
axes[0, 2].bar(x + 1.5*width, occupation_stats['Daily Steps']/1000, width, label='Daily Steps/1000', color='gold')
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Score / Normalized Value', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Average Health Metrics by Occupation (Top 10)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].set_xticks(x)
axes[0, 2].set_xticklabels(occupation_stats.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 2].legend(fontsize=10)

# 4. Correlation Heatmap
correlation_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                    'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[correlation_cols].corr()
im = axes[1, 0].imshow(corr_matrix, cmap='coolwarm', vmin=-1, vmax=1)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(np.arange(len(correlation_cols)))
axes[1, 0].set_yticks(np.arange(len(correlation_cols)))
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(correlation_cols, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 0].set_yticklabels(correlation_cols, fontsize=10)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Health Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=axes[1, 0])
cbar.set_label('Correlation Coefficient', fontsize=10)

# Add correlation values
for i in range(len(correlation_cols)):
    for j in range(len(correlation_cols)):
        text = axes[1, 0].text(j, i, f'{corr_matrix.iloc[i, j]:.2f}',
                              ha="center", va="center", color="white", fontsize=8)

# 5. Boxplot of Stress Level by BMI Category and Sleep Disorder
df_sleep_disorder = df.copy()
df_sleep_disorder['Sleep Disorder'] = df_sleep_disorder['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
sns.boxplot(x='BMI Category', y='Stress Level', hue='Sleep Disorder', 
            data=df_sleep_disorder, ax=axes[1, 1], order=bmi_order)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Stress Level by BMI Category and Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Sleep Disorder', fontsize=9)

# 6. Scatter matrix of key metrics
metrics = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 'Daily Steps']
sample_size = min(100, len(df))
sampled_df = df.sample(sample_size, random_state=42)
colors = sampled_df['Stress Level']

scatter = axes[1, 2].scatter(sampled_df['Sleep Duration'], sampled_df['Quality of Sleep'],
                            c=colors, cmap='plasma', s=sampled_df['Daily Steps']/50, alpha=0.7)
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].set_title('Sleep Quality vs Duration\n(Color=Stress, Size=Daily Steps)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[1, 2])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level', fontsize=10)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
